entities.summary: Catholic University of the North is a university in Chile. It is part of the Chilean Traditional Universities. It is located in Antofagasta, Chile. The Catholic University of the North was founded on May 31, 1956. Catholic University of the North is a research institute in Americas, established in 1956. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
